title: Agent output — identical for every configuration
description: Per-axis results with explicit uncertainty; execution status is separate from scientific abstention; usage is written by the HARNESS, not the agent, and graded from the harness copy.

configuration.description: A0 | A | B | C | mock* | BLIND (stripped for grading)

execution_status.description: Anything other than `completed` is a run failure. It receives NO credit on any scientific row; `overall.verdict` is then `not_assessable` by construction and means nothing.

evidence.description: observation_ids (obs_*) or reference keys (gtex, ensembl_orthology.mus_musculus, impc) that this axis verdict rests on. Must exist in the case.

contrast_alignment.description: the declared basis on which the two contrasts are comparable; null = none, in which case the verdict must be not_assessable

source.description: dataset id, observation_id, or reference key (mygene | ensembl_orthology.<species> | impc | gtex)

locator.description: for observations: the observation_id or a JSON path under it; for references: a JSON path under sources.<key>. Grader resolves it — a locator that does not resolve is a failed citation.

status_interpretation.description: How each non-ok reference source was interpreted. Graded STRUCTURALLY (review §3): keys are source keys, values are the interpretation.

harness_signed.description: true only on the harness-written copy under runs/<batch>/usage/. The grader ignores usage inside the agent output.

_ledger.description: enforced-checklist configurations only; stripped before grading
